plugins.description: v8.16.0 (2026-06-28, MINOR — autonomous bugfix of 2 glitches caught by the v8.15.0 E2E evaluator during the v8.15.1 self-audit run): (Glitch A — HIGH missing_step:final) F1 in tests/regression/v8.16.0/ pins the existing step-ledger-stamp.cjs contract (final-validator return → `final` stamped; raw V1 fence string accepted; errored/ungoverned returns rejected) so a future regression to the stamping path is caught immediately. Both fixes land in ONE existing hook via the SSOT step-1-7-routing writer; no new hook, no new gate, the Mandatory Gates table + Gate Registry untouched. TDD RED→GREEN via tests/regression/v8.16.0/F1 + F2 (12 sub-cases). Suite 234/4 (baseline 232 + the 2 new files; 4 pre-existing Langfuse/env failures unchanged). Iron Law preserved: only .claude/hooks/step-ledger-stamp.cjs + tests/ touched. v8.15.1 (2026-06-27, PATCH — audit read-budget dispatch-exemption persistence fix): writeLedger() in lib/audit-read-budget.cjs now preserves the dispatched flag across writes, so the PostToolUse read-counter no longer wipes the markDispatched exemption on the first read — a dispatched audit/review subagent stays exempt from the inline read budget for the whole governed window instead of being re-blocked after one read (the gate was starving its own dispatched reviewers). TDD RED→GREEN via tests/regression/v8.14.0/F11; adversarial review 0 critical/0 high/0 medium; suite 232/4; only lib/ + tests/ touched. writeLedger() in lib/audit-read-budget.cjs now preserves the dispatched flag across writes, so the PostToolUse read-counter no longer wipes the markDispatched exemption on the first read — a dispatched audit/review subagent stays exempt from the inline read budget for the whole governed window instead of being re-blocked after one read (the gate was starving its own dispatched reviewers). TDD RED→GREEN via tests/regression/v8.14.0/F11; adversarial review 0 critical/0 high/0 medium; suite 232/4; only lib/ + tests/ touched. v8.15.0 (2026-06-26, MINOR — chain-tied enforcement remediation + e2e self-evaluation loop):marker reading consolidated into one SSOT lib (lib/arm-pending.cjs) shared by the arm-gate, the audit-read-budget gate and a new audit-dispatch-marker hook; the audit read-budget exempts genuinely dispatched subagents; 3 final-review security findings fixed (SEC-1 dispatch-mark allowlist, SEC-3 deny-message no longer leaks the exec-window path, SEC-4 injection-safe MODE/Type workflow label). Plus an e2e self-evaluation loop (lib/e2e-evaluator.cjs over lib/contracts/e2e-eval.cjs, e2e-eval-gate.cjs, /self-eval) that scores a finished run and surfaces human-gated improvement proposals at Stop. Known limitation: cooperative enforcement (prompt-based, not cryptographic against the parent); full closure needs PIPELINE_HMAC_STRICT default-on plugin-wide (deferred). Suite 232/4. Iron Law preserved (Mandatory Gates table + Gate Registry untouched). v8.0.3 (2026-06-17, PATCH — protocol doc guard): adds an explicit anti-pattern note in references/gate-request-protocol.md (parent-side handler) and skills/spec/SKILL.md (Achado #7 handler) — re-dispatch is a fresh Agent() call that re-hydrates state from the run-dir, NOT a live-agent resume; SendMessage is not used by this pipeline and, even where present, is a deferred tool loadable via ToolSearch. Closes the failure mode where the parent main LLM mis-reads an AWAITING_* handshake as needing SendMessage and abandons the run. ZERO runtime change. v8.0.2 (2026-06-16, PATCH — release hygiene): clean npm tarball (drops a leaked runtime session .lock and tracks the previously npm-only /help command; .npmignore hardened for **/.pipeline/ + *.lock; new tests/packaging/no-pack-cruft guard), the Paperclip flow-mirror tests are now wired into the release gate (run-tests.cjs `paperclip` category, 13/13), and the stale description/README prose was refreshed. ZERO runtime change. v8.0.1 (2026-06-15, PATCH — Paperclip layer): reflects the v8.0.0 spec-authoring takeover + fixes the flow-mirror handoff stalls (Montagem Progressiva + structural root-cause guards), additive in references/paperclip, cursor manifest lockstep. v8.0.0 (2026-06-15, MAJOR — spec-authoring takeover): /pipeline-orchestrator:spec now AUTHORS a new specification from scratch (brainstorm clarification + proactive ideation + forced design-interrogation + Kiro lifecycle + adversarial document review + contract seal) and stops before implementing; legacy spec PROCESSING moved to /spec-light, /spec-heavy, /spec-audit-only and /pipeline --type=Spec. Gate Registry 35→43 (8 new AUDIT/SOFT events; the Mandatory Gates by Complexity table is unchanged, F1 preserved). v7.14.1 (2026-06-14, PATCH - gate-decision SSOT shipped / schema-drift fix): entrega a Fase 1 do contract-enforcement ja mergeada em main (commit 4420907) - novo lib/contracts/gate-decision.cjs como fonte unica do vocabulario canonico (8 decisoes + 5 hardness + 13 chaves) consumido por gate-decision-writer + jsonl-sanitizer + fidelity-reporter; encerra o drift que fazia final-validator/pipeline-controller/audit-trail exigirem exatamente 8 chaves e procurarem um RESOLVED nunca emitido, fazendo o plugin reprovar o proprio audit trail de 13 campos. Prosa alinhada ao writer real; novo teste tests/regression/v7.9.0/F-gate-decision-contract (10/10). Auditoria audit-heavy do proprio pipeline (2026-06-14) confirmou base correta v7.14.0, integracao limpa e zero regressao (suite 114/4/118; 4 falhas pre-existentes Langfuse+flaky). Iron Law: quebra minima em agents/lib/commands/references reconhecida e justificada pelo bug de auto-auditoria. v7.10.1 (2026-06-09, PATCH — parallel_eligible default contract): formaliza o default de parallel_eligible como false quando a analise de sobreposicao nao pode ser concluida. plan-architect ganha Regra 5 exigindo parallel_eligible: false com overlap_reason prefixado 'analysis_incomplete:' quando CHANGE_CONTRACT esta ausente ou contem wildcards. executor-controller ganha guarda explicito tratando parallel_eligible ausente como false com WARN trace, convertendo comportamento implicito JS falsy em contrato observavel. 2 cenarios de regressao adicionados (F22-S10 + F22-S11, total 11). Dogfood validou Plan Mode protocol: 3/3 agentes obrigatorios emitiram PLAN_MODE_REQUEST na primeira tentativa. v7.10.0 (2026-06-09, MINOR — Plan Mode generalized + parallel dispatch): generaliza o Plan Mode obrigatorio de 1 para 10 agentes (7 de pesquisa + 2 implementadores + plan-architect) e implementa despacho paralelo de tarefas em lotes MEDIA. Cada agente obrigatorio (step-01-explore, audit-intake, audit-domain-analyzer, bugfix-diagnostic-agent, bugfix-root-cause-analyzer, feature-vertical-slice-planner, design-interrogator, executor-implementer-task, feature-implementer) agora emite PLAN_MODE_REQUEST v1 como Step 0/0b antes de qualquer pesquisa pesada, delegando leitura ao parent em isolamento somente-leitura. Enforcement PLAN_MODE_BYPASS generalizado no pipeline-controller: qualquer agente da tabela PLAN_MODE_MANDATORY_AGENTS que retornar sem ciclo REQUEST/RESULTS dispara AUDIT + re-dispatch unico. Novo campo parallel_eligible nos metadados de batch emitidos pelo plan-architect: quando as tarefas de um lote tem escopos de arquivo disjuntos (CHANGE_CONTRACT sem sobreposicao), o executor-controller despacha N implementadores simultaneamente. checkpoint-validator ganha campo per_task_status condicional para atribuir falhas por tarefa em lotes paralelos. Revisao adversarial com 3 revisores zero-context: 6 fixes aplicados (ADV-001 IMPLEMENTATION_RESULT na lista de saidas substantivas, ADV-002 enforcement delegation clarity, COR-001/002 micro-gate exempt from Plan Mode precondition, COR-003/004 CONTEXT LOADING STRATEGY as delegation definition, ADV-006 conditional per_task_status, COR-005 VSA_PLAN source). 4 novos arquivos de teste em tests/regression/v7.10.0/ (F20 45 cenarios + F21 14 cenarios + F22 9 cenarios + F23 6 cenarios = 74 total). Iron Law preservada: references/gates.md, hooks e lib intocados; 35-gate Registry e 23-row Mandatory Gates untouched. v7.9.4 (2026-06-06, PATCH — plan-mode contract fix): corrige o contrato do Plan Mode que nunca disparava (21+ runs reais sem nenhum PLAN_MODE_REQUEST; modo de falha B5-001). agents/quality/plan-architect.md: Steps 0/3/4 + rodape Tools + 4 claims de header alinhados ao protocolo Achado #7 — o agente agora emite PLAN_MODE_REQUEST (Step 0) e GATE_REQUEST (Step 3) e PARA, em vez de tentar chamar EnterPlanMode/ExitPlanMode/AskUserQuestion (ferramentas strippadas de subagentes pelo harness); rodape Tools lista apenas Read/Grep/Glob + blocos de protocolo; label da Rule 1 preservado para o contrato D7-S7 v6.1.0. agents/core/pipeline-controller.md: novo enforcement PLAN_MODE_BYPASS — retorno do plan-architect contendo IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN sem ciclo PLAN_MODE_REQUEST/PLAN_MODE_RESULTS gera evento AUDIT em protocol-events.jsonl + um unico re-dispatch; aceita no segundo bypass (sem deadlock em sessoes legadas); NAO e gate novo (registry de 35 e Inline Invariants intocados). 2 testes novos em tests/regression/v7.9.4/ (F18 plan-mode-contract, 8 cenarios com extractor fence-aware provado por mutacao; F19 controller-inline-plan-check, 6 cenarios) pinam o contrato. Dogfood run completo: Bug Fix/MEDIA/bugfix-light, TDD 14 cenarios RED→GREEN, adversarial per-batch (B1/B2 PASS), final adversarial com 3 revisores zero-context (0 critical; 2 importants corrigidos em rework unico, incl. regressao D7-S7 detectada por verificacao direta e reconciliada), Pa de Cal GO @ 0.94; suite 62/67 = baseline pre-run identico (5 falhas Langfuse/env pre-existentes). Iron Law preservada: references/gates.md, hooks e lib intocados. v7.9.2 (2026-06-02, PATCH — documentation refresh): atualiza toda a documentacao de usuario e referencia para refletir as features ate v7.9.1 — README e diagramas saem de v7.4.0/v6.0.0 para v7.9.2 (incl. correcao da licenca MIT->PolyForm Shield nos diagramas), documentacao completa da camada Paperclip (integration layer v7.6.0 + company provisioner v7.8.0 + flow-mirror v7.9.0 com arvore de issues + 8 comandos paperclip-* + flag --on=paperclip + novo references/paperclip/PAPERCLIP-FLOW-MIRROR.md), secao run-log do audit-trail atualizada para o modelo v7.9.1 (buildRunLogEntry derivando total_gates_expected/fidelity_score/final_decision), vocabulario de decisao de gate alinhado aos 8 valores canonicos, e correcao de drift de contagens (gate registry header 22->35, Mandatory table 22->23, suite 61). Docs-only: ZERO mudancas em codigo de runtime; Iron Law preservada. v7.9.1 (2026-06-02, PATCH — telemetry run-log aggregator fix): buildRunLogEntry (.claude/hooks/stop-hook.cjs + .codex mirror) had 4 confirmed defects in the per-session run-log summary. D2: read classification from sentinel.classification_post_orchestrator instead of the source of truth sentinel.orchestrator_decision (type/complexity/variant came out null almost always) — now reads orchestrator_decision (.type/.task_type/.complexity/.pipeline_variant) with legacy fallback. D1: total_gates_expected + fidelity_score were hardcoded null — now total_gates_expected derives from MANDATORY_GATES_BY_COMPLEXITY (MEDIA=11; lazy-required channel-agnostic, soft-fail null) and fidelity_score is read from the run's persisted fidelity-report.json. D3: final_decision fell to literal UNKNOWN even when derivable — now cascades session.status -> sentinel.final_decision -> last CLOSEOUT_CONFIRM in gate-decisions.jsonl before UNKNOWN. TDD: new tests/regression/v7.9.0/F13-runlog-entry-defects.test.cjs (15 scenarios) RED 7-fail -> GREEN 15/15; full suite 61/61; build exit 0. .codex mirror byte-identical (sha256). Option A: scope locked to 2 hooks + 1 test, lib/run-log.cjs untouched (its null->0 coercion is an intentional honest default). Iron Law preserved: ZERO changes to agents/skills/references/commands/lib; Mandatory Gates + Registry untouched. v7.9.0 (2026-06-01, MINOR — Paperclip flow-mirror): espelha os 14 fluxos do pipeline (bugfix/feature/user-story/audit/ux/spec light+heavy + hotfix + review-only) como arvores de issues no Paperclip via novos modulos em references/paperclip/spec/lib/ (tree-template moldes declarativos dos 14 fluxos; tree-factory nextStep/nodeSpec/nodeSpecFanIn/expandSlices com loop de conserto por contador interno + fatias dinamicas; tree-factory-io + grow-tree braco I/O com transport injetavel e guard dry-run/--confirm que NAO toca a producao sem confirmacao; classify-bridge classificacao local tipo+complexidade). Patch na regua mirror-fidelity-dictionary.cjs: CLARIFICATION_DONE -> INFO_GATE_BLOCKED (teto SIMPLES 0.80 -> 1.0) + modo REVIEW_ONLY com lista fixa de portoes. 8 novos comandos slash commands/paperclip-{bugfix,feature,user-story,audit,ux,spec,hotfix,review}.md + paperclip-overview.md: cada um classifica local, monta a arvore em dry-run e SO cria os cartoes na VPS apos confirmacao explicita (AskUserQuestion); flag --on=paperclip documentada em commands/pipeline.md. Construido com DDD+ATDD+BDD+TDD + revisao adversarial em loop por etapa (72 achados corrigidos); suite mirror-fidelity 63 -> 309 GREEN. Aditivo: os comandos paperclip-* sao canal paralelo de despacho, ZERO mudancas que quebrem fluxos do Claude Code; Iron Law respeitada nos agents/skills/references originais. v7.8.0 (2026-05-26, MINOR - Paperclip company provisioner): ships references/paperclip/scripts/provision-pipeline-company.cjs, an ID-agnostic Node provisioner that stands up a Paperclip company with the full 47-cargo pipeline-orchestrator roster + 11 custom skills (heartbeat OFF — inert until an issue is assigned). Resolves the company by name (creates if absent), captures agent IDs at runtime, computes all plugin/skill/workflow paths from __dirname (no hardcoded UUIDs or machine paths), and wires the 12 category->skill + category->workflow-spec mappings from PLAN-46-AGENTS-UPDATE. Referenced by the /pipeline-orchestrator:setup-paperclip command as the programmatic provisioning step. Iron Law respected: additive script + doc only; ZERO changes to existing agents/, skills/, references/ originals, commands/ originals or lib/. v7.7.0 (2026-05-25, MINOR - OpenCode adaptation marketplace release): ships the OpenCode adaptation harness, commands, agents, skills, contract tests, and hardened physical-evidence gates for bugfix, feature, audit, UX, SPEC, final validation, and closeout. Global OpenCode commands now include audit/UX/SPEC light and heavy flows. v7.6.1 (2026-05-24, PATCH — release hygiene): CLAUDE.md canonical version line bumped 7.5.0 → 7.6.0 (was lagging since v7.6.0 release), .cursor-plugin/plugin.json description re-synced to match .claude-plugin/plugin.json (was lagging at v7.4.1 desc), tests/regression/v7.1.0/F7_version_sync.cjs VERSION constant updated 7.5.0 → 7.6.0 then to 7.6.1 (rolled forward per release convention). Suite 58/59 GREEN (1 pre-existing F2 langfuse vendoring failure documented and accepted as v7.4.2 baseline). ZERO runtime/agent/skill/reference/command changes — purely release hygiene closure of doc drift detected by F7 during v7.6.0 npm publish. v7.6.0 (2026-05-22, MINOR — Paperclip integration layer): adiciona references/paperclip/ com 14 documentos + 11 skills custom que permitem rodar o plugin pipeline-orchestrator dentro do Paperclip (open-source agent orchestration platform — paperclip.ing) via adapter claude_local com paridade efetiva ao Claude Code standalone. Inclui PAPERCLIP-AXIOMS.md (contrato inquebravel + 4 axiomas), 6 workflow specs prompt-native (PAPERCLIP-{BUGFIX,FEATURE,AUDIT,UX,SPEC,ADVERSARIAL}-WORKFLOW.md), 11 skills wrappers (engineering-principles canonica + 10 pipeline-orchestrator-*), paperclip-kb.md (KB operacional — heartbeat 9 steps, skills system, PARA memory, adapter config codex_local + claude_local, API endpoints), paperclip-catalog.md (46 agentes mapeados com 8 campos cada), paperclip-adaptation-spec.md (traducao Achado #7 para modelo Paperclip), ZONING.md (regra D: canonical vs C: install vs workspace local), PLAN-46-AGENTS-UPDATE.md (procedimento de migracao com loop adversarial 7 batches), pilot-information-gate.md (validacao end-to-end PARITY_VERDICT=PASS_WITH_NOTES — leu agent.md original, GATE_REQUEST v1 schema confirmado, 22 skills detectadas, 4 references auxiliares lidas), install-junctions.bat (deployment de skills via mklink /J Windows), novo slash command /pipeline-orchestrator:setup-paperclip (orquestra deteccao + install + configuracao end-to-end) e nova doc docs/PAPERCLIP-INTEGRATION.md (visao geral arquitetura + setup + gaps conhecidos). Iron Law respeitado: ZERO mudancas em agents/, skills/ existentes, references/ originais (paperclip/ eh subdir adicional), commands/ originais ou lib/. 23-row Mandatory Gates table e 35-row Registry untouched. Backward compat 100%. v7.5.0 (2026-05-22, MINOR — concurrent-safe tracing): isolates concurrent pipeline runs sharing a working directory so trace/span carriers, manifest allocation, and sentinel state discovery no longer collide on PPID or mtime heuristics. lib/run-directory.cjs::allocate switches the primary mkdir from {recursive:true} to {recursive:false} and retries on EEXIST with a fresh collision-resistant uniqueId (Date.now base36 + crypto.randomBytes(6).hex). The resulting runId — `${ordinal}-${uniqueId}-${slug}` — is published on process.env.PIPELINE_RUN_ID so descendant processes (langfuse-hook, sentinel-hook, stop-hook) key per-run state off the env-var instead of process.ppid or sentinel-state.json mtime. All three hooks fall back gracefully when PIPELINE_RUN_ID is absent, emitting one-shot AUDIT events (CARRIER_PPID_FALLBACK / DISCOVERY_RUN_ID_NO_MATCH / DISCOVERY_MTIME_FALLBACK) on stderr so the degradation is observable. New PIPELINE_TRACING_SCOPE env-var (`agent-only` default = v7.4.0 parity / `agent-plus-skill` / `full`) replaces the silent `tool !== 'Agent'` filter at langfuse-hook entry-point; unknown values fall through to safe-default with AUDIT TRACING_SCOPE_UNKNOWN. Codex mirror kept byte-identical per Iron Law. 5 new regression tests in tests/regression/v7.5.0/ (F1-F5, 44 sub-assertions, 100% GREEN). Existing unit tests in tests/unit/run-directory.test.js updated to the new runId format (external_consumers=none per spec.json). Backward-compat preserved: legacy single-arg PPID callers get the fallback path + AUDIT breadcrumb. v7.4.2 (2026-05-22, PATCH — Langfuse SDK vendored: bundles langfuse@3.38.4 + langfuse-core@3.38.20 + mustache@4.2.0 into the package so the cache works without a global install; closes Cannot find module 'langfuse' in marketplace cache). Automated multi-agent pipeline. v7.2.0 (2026-05-21) — MINOR. Phase 0 hardening: (1) STATE_FILE_INIT_FAIL gate (CIRCUIT_BREAKER) — hard precondition on the initial sentinel-state.json write, with happy-path PASS entry to preserve fidelity score; (2) PROTOCOL_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT gate (HARD) — two-layer detection (primary out-of-band hook + secondary controller re-entry check) for stale GATE_REQUEST/DISPATCH_REQUEST/PLAN_MODE_REQUEST blocks; default 30min, env override PIPELINE_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS with 60000ms floor; closes Achado #7 silent-deadlock pattern; (3) cleanup-orphan-sentinel-state-hook (.claude/hooks/, SessionStart) — auto-archives sentinel-state.json files older than 24h via atomic rename to sentinel-state.archived-<ts>.json (closes Achado B1-001); sandbox-checked cwd, depth-limited walk, symlink-skip; (4) --strict-spec flag — rejects Signal 3 (prose regex) and Signal 4 (glob fallback) Spec detection in unattended/CI mode where AskUserQuestion is unavailable; preserves Signal 1 (explicit path) and Signal 2 (--type=spec); precedence over conflicting FORCE_VARIANT=spec-*; STRICT_SPEC_REJECTION gate (AUDIT) logged. Gate Registry 32 → 35 rows (Core 16→18 + Routing 3→4). Mandatory Gates 22 → 23 (+STATE_FILE_INIT_FAIL). 4 batches with ATDD/BDD per scenario, TDD red→green per file, adversarial review per batch (22 findings addressed: 3 CRITICAL fixed, 12 HIGH fixed). Suite 45/46 green (F7 version-sync updated). v7.1.1 (2026-05-21) — PATCH (docs only). Enriches docs/diagrams/pipeline-overview.html with a new "Fluxos detalhados ponta a ponta" section covering 7 workflows end-to-end (bugfix light/heavy, audit light/heavy, UX sim light/heavy, plan, brainstorm, hotfix, review-only) with 12 inline SVG step diagrams (agents + gates color-coded) and a full Thariq-style interactive layer (sticky TOC pills, light/heavy filter pills, per-flow review checkboxes with localStorage persistence, per-flow Copy summary buttons, collapsible exemplo cards, response form with 11-option radio + notes + Save/Copy/Clear actions, 7/7 review counter). ZERO changes to agents/, skills/, references/, commands/, hooks/, lib/ or tests/ — pure documentation enrichment. Iron Law preserved: 22-row Mandatory Gates table and 27-row Registry untouched. v7.1.0 (2026-05-19) — MINOR. Telemetry hygiene: new lib/gate-decision-writer.cjs SSOT writer with the canonical 8-value decision vocabulary (BLOCKED, DISPATCHED, SKIPPED, APPROVED, CONFIRMED, REJECTED, TRIGGERED, NOT_TRIGGERED) — runtime throws TypeError on unknown values (defense-in-depth paired with diff-discipline-reviewer's new SSOT-bypass check). Every event auto-carries run_id/plugin_version/schema_version/type/complexity correlation envelope so cross-run analytics no longer require folder-path joins. New .claude/hooks/stop-hook.cjs (registered in .claude/settings.json) calls lib/run-log.cjs::appendRunLog on every Claude Code session end including crashes — closes the 1-line-per-20-runs aggregate bug (Finding #6). lib/fidelity-reporter.cjs VALID_HARDNESS gains AUDIT (was missing since v6.2.0); VALID_DECISION widened to all 8 canonical values; validate*() now pushes a warning to fidelity-report's warnings[] when an invalid value is encountered (was silently nullified). 7 regression tests in tests/regression/v7.1.0/ (F1-F7). 4 agent prose files updated to reference the canonical vocabulary. Backward compat: historical events still tolerated as '(invalid)' (no migration); 22-row Mandatory Gates table and 27-row Registry untouched. Deferred to v7.2.0: gate rename (CHECKPOINT_FAIL/PLAN_REJECTED for clarity) and timestamp format normalization. v7.0.0 (2026-05-19) — MAJOR (license-only). Licensed under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 (source-available, noncompete clause). All v7.0.0 code is identical to v6.3.0; the major bump signals license-only change per SemVer convention. See LICENSE and NOTICE.md. v6.3.0 (2026-05-19) — MINOR. Implementation Discipline Layer: new SSOT `references/implementation-discipline.md` (scope control, minimal diff, SOLID/KISS/DRY/YAGNI, dependency/config/contract/migration restrictions, test integrity, evidence requirements, severity PASS/NEEDS_REDUCTION/REJECTED). plan-architect emits `CHANGE_CONTRACT` inline in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN (allowed_files, allowed_new_files, forbidden_files, forbidden_change_types, diff_budget, escalation_required_if, bootstrap). executor-implementer-task gains SCOPE LOCK CHECK section that fires before every Write/Edit (Read remains free; on violation returns status=QUESTIONS with question.context=scope_lock_violation). New agent `agents/quality/diff-discipline-reviewer.md` (tools=Read,Grep,Glob only; static-only inspection; verdict PASS/NEEDS_REDUCTION/REJECTED; max_fix_attempts=5 independent from ADVERSARIAL_BLOCK max=3). review-orchestrator wires diff-discipline as third parallel reviewer alongside adversarial-batch + architecture-reviewer with dual fix_loop_counters. architecture-reviewer adds 5 new checks (abstraction without second use case, new file where local change suffices, unnecessary architecture layer, unrelated refactor, public contract drift) plus 2 reused existing checks (duplicated helper/type/constant, semantic duplication). 7 regression tests in tests/regression/v6.3.0/ (F8-F14). 22-row Mandatory Gates by Complexity invariant preserved (NO new gate added to that table; F1 untouched); Registry stays at 27 rows (F14 defense-in-depth confirms). Bootstrap exception: this release itself created the very enforcement machinery — T1-T3 of v6.3.0 ran without SCOPE LOCK CHECK enforcement (mechanism being born); from T4 onward in this release and all subsequent plans, enforcement is active. Bootstrap flag is one-time-only and locks itself in v6.4.0+. v6.2.0 (2026-05-18) — MINOR. Pre-execution clarification overhaul: replaces fixed 7-question brainstorm template with a 4-phase dynamic agent (Phase A reads project context + likely-affected files BEFORE any question; Phase B inventories gaps across 11 lenses + domain extensions for auth/payment/PII/migration/concurrency; Phase C asks one GATE_REQUEST per real gap with mandatory file:line evidence in option descriptions; Phase D records 02-explore.md + emits structured JSONL telemetry). Adds new step-01b-alternatives agent (proposes 2-4 alternative approaches across Minimal/Pattern-aligned/Aggressive/Contrarian axes after clarification, auto-skips for mechanical tasks). Drift fix on references/complexity-matrix.md: 'Has spec' column for MEDIA changed from 'Optional' to 'Required (auto-dispatch)', matching pipeline-controller.md:281 runtime behavior. Adds 5 new gates (CLARIFICATION_GAPS_DETECTED, CLARIFICATION_RESOLVED, CLARIFICATION_SKIPPED, ALTERNATIVES_PROPOSED, ALTERNATIVE_CHOSEN) plus new AUDIT hardness level (informational telemetry, never blocks, excluded from fidelity scoring). Gate registry 22 → 27. Brainstorm controller step table grows 9 → 10. Dogfood evidence preserved in docs/audits/2026-05-18-clarification-overhaul-dogfood/ (real MEDIA scenario against IFRS 16 contracts.py:232 list_contracts; 14 telemetry events; 4 anti-invention blockers surfaced — streaming/PII/cap/timeout — that the legacy 7-Q template would have left for downstream invention).
